name: lilygo-t-eth-lite-s3
title: LilyGO T-ETH-Lite ESP32-S3
notes: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM). Soldered W5500: SCLK 10, MOSI 12, MISO 11, CS 9, INT 13, RST 14. TF slot on its own SPI bus: SCLK 7, MOSI 6, MISO 5, CS 42. Optional PoE shield (802.3af) on the 2x4 header. Pins: T-ETH-Lite-ESP32S3 schematic V1.0, LilyGO utilities.h, arduino-esp32 lilygo_t_eth_lite variant. The wiki quick-start's pin list (IRQ 21, SCK 12, MISO 13, MOSI 11) contradicts the schematic: the schematic's taken. No LED the firmware can drive.
